title: Horrible experience
body: They are forcing me to pay for this app you will I already paid once. They are removing and limiting functionality and pushing me with annoying banner, to pay again really awful attitude from them, and do not recommend to buy or install this application.
author: Baterage

title: It is impossible to use
body: It was a great app with a beautiful interface that was easy to use. But now it is completely unusable, it has actually become unworkable. The response time after clicking is 2-3 seconds, sometimes more than 5, any click causes almost physical pain from the terrible performance of the application. I am very sorry for the money for the annual subscription, I do not recommend it to anyone.

title: A gift to yourself
body: I really hate “a gift to yourself” banner.  It slows down the app. Is this really “LIMITED TIME OFFER?” I’ve already paid once, it’s been a long time ago. I don’t want another update anymore.

title: So buggy that it is pain to use
body: It used to be great app, but now it’s full of bugs. These bugs prevail for months although I had reported them. And with every update, new bugs are introduced. No transparency from the developer regarding bugs - just check version history, they use the same template to describe “changes”.

title: Otravná reklama
body: Hezká aplikace. Ale neuvěřitelně mě štve, že POKAŽDÉ, když aplikaci otevřu mi vnucuje   GROWTH BUNDLE a není tam možnost toto odmítnout napořád. Takže tím že mám premium verzi jsem si vysloužila tuhle otravnou reklamu na něco o co nestojím. Momentálně píšu v návalu nasranosti (nenávidím otravné a stále se vnucující reklamy), ale místo osobního růstu mám akorát vztek, přitom by stačilo jedno tlačítko "nemám zájem a příště už nezobrazovat"
